description: This file defines the ProjectChannelListener class which listens to specific application events related to project creation and HTTP requests. It adjusts project node assignments and manages redirects based on questionnaires when a project is created.

classes.name: ProjectChannelListener
classes.description: Listener for handling project creation and request events, applying channel logic, and redirecting based on questionnaires.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP request events, specifically to detect POST requests to the project creation controller.

methods.name: onProjectCreated
methods.description: Triggered after a project is created; assigns a node and redirects if applicable based on questionnaires.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping events to handler methods for event subscription.
